title: Project Falsifiable Research Claims
purpose: Provide a schema-valid starting point for repository-owned, evidence-bounded claims.

authority.change_policy: Replace or extend this template through issue-scoped review while preserving baseline, condition, failure modes, measurements, and proof references. Accelerator image definitions remain available, but NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel CI and release paths are inactive until matching host runners are deliberately registered; ordinary semantic-tag releases publish CPU and Apple only. Keep CPU and Apple arm64 active; retain NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel paths as inactive manual opt-ins until matching hosts are registered, and publish only active images on semantic tags. The Docker launcher now preserves the container argv contract: runtime flags precede the image and KAITE_CONTAINER_COMMAND follows it, so published-image smoke checks exercise the intended command instead of attempting to pull a command name as an image. Active semantic releases use native host jobs: CPU publishes on ubuntu-24.04 as linux/amd64 and Apple publishes on ubuntu-24.04-arm as linux/arm64; inactive NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel paths remain manual opt-ins. Release promotion is implemented as a Release Please PR, immutable tag, explicit tagged image dispatch, native active-image smoke, and GHCR publication. Added slim/full AI/ML image variants, native CPU and Apple host matrices, Buildkite agent verification, and portability smoke evidence. Verified active CPU slim/full builds and smokes, embedded Buildkite agent versions, native host release matrices, and explicit inactive accelerator paths. Repository publish polish: split Go supervisor by concern, sync version constant to 0.2.0, rewrite README/CONTRIBUTING, and align living specs with the maintained layout. Added docs/architecture.md as the human system-layout home linked from the root README. Release image promotion (PR #11): Release Please must workflow_dispatch release-images.yml with actions:write; without it tags/releases appear but GHCR stays empty (v0.2.0). Active matrix is cpu/apple slim+full; accelerators remain manual opt-in. Production-legit release surface (post v0.2.1): release-images.yml annotates existing GitHub Releases with GHCR pull docs via --notes-file (never --generate-notes); supervisor version constant lockstep at 0.2.1; public-ready README/SECURITY.md; GHCR package visibility is independent of repo visibility and requires an explicit Public setting for anonymous pulls; Decapod pin/entrypoints track 0.96.18.

methodology.falsifiability_standard: Every claim names a baseline, an observable condition, a failure mode, measurable evidence, and a proof gate.

measurement_rules.name: Proof reference
measurement_rules.requirement: A passing claim must identify the artifact or command that supports it.

claims.title: Repository claims require explicit evidence
claims.statement: A repository capability should not be treated as established until its baseline, observable condition, failure mode, measurements, and proof gate are recorded.
claims.why_it_matters: A structured claim prevents completion language from being mistaken for measured evidence.

baseline.description: Review a repository capability without a claims ledger.
protocol: Record the capability without a structured claim.
Attempt to identify the evidence supporting the capability.
controls: Use the same repository capability in both conditions.

decapod_condition.description: Review the same capability with this claims ledger and its referenced proof artifacts.
protocol: Record observable failure modes and proof references.
Run the required validation command before promotion.
controls: Use the same repository capability and observation window.

failure_modes.description: The claim is recorded without a resolvable proof artifact.
failure_modes.observable_signal: The proof gate references a missing or invalid file.
failure_modes.falsifier: Validation reports a missing or invalid required proof artifact.

measurements.name: Proof gate result
measurements.definition: Whether the required validation command exits successfully.
measurements.collection_method: Run the command named by the proof gate.

required_artifacts.relationship: contains the repository-owned claim and its evidence contract

acceptance_criteria: Replace this template claim with a project-specific, issue-reviewed claim.
Keep all proof references resolvable and evidence status bounded by observation.
proof_gate.failure_behavior: Keep the claim unsupported and repair or remove the invalid proof reference before publication.

open_questions.question: Which project capability should replace this template claim first?
open_questions.decision_impact: Determines the first repository-specific research claim and its required proof.

evidence.summary: v0.2.1 active GHCR images (cpu/apple slim+full) published and verified; release annotate job still failed on --generate-notes (fixed in this PR); supervisor version aligned to 0.2.1; package remains private pending operator UI action.

sources.description: Issue defining the deterministic claims-ledger template and repair path.

observations.result: A schema-valid claims ledger template is available for replacement by project maintainers.
Images for v0.2.1 present on GHCR; annotate job rewritten; version.go=0.2.1; SECURITY.md added; go test ./... passed.

non_guarantees: The generated template is not evidence that the project capability has been measured.
The template does not replace human review or issue-scoped claim maintenance.

governance.review_policy: Reviewers must check that every claim remains falsifiable, evidence status is bounded by observed evidence, proof references resolve, and schema compatibility is preserved.
governance.new_capability_rule: Every new capability must map to an existing claim or introduce a new falsifiable claim before it is treated as research-relevant.
